_note: Parameters of the outdoor voice-alert model (brief v3, Appendix A; formula in docs/coverage-model.md). low / base / high, each with its basis. 'sourced' values cite analysis/data/sources.json ids; everything else is an assumption to replace with field measurements (the pilot sound check).
_method: L(r) = L_src at 100 ft - D log2(r / 30.48 m) - air (r - 30.48 m) - forest x (metres of path beyond the village clearing). Heard where L(r) >= ambient + margin (+ building loss indoors). Terrain shadowing waits for the Copernicus DEM (Stage 3).

src_t0_db.label: Station tower array, level at 100 ft
src_t0_db.note: 3.2 kW class, the speaker in the station cost model

src_t1_db.label: Village speaker, level at 100 ft
src_t1_db.note: 400-800 W voice speaker, smaller than the tower array; the MOD5020 class is 120 dB

d_land_db.label: Spreading and ground loss per doubling of distance, land
d_land_db.note: 6 = FEMA soft ground beyond about 250 ft; 10 = vendor outdoor-siren rule

d_water_db.label: Same, over open water
d_water_db.note: FEMA: hard surfaces and water lose about 3 dB per doubling

air_db_km.label: Air absorption at 1 kHz, 30 °C, high humidity
air_db_km.note: From ISO 9613-1 tables; compute exactly in Stage 3

forest_db_100m.label: Forest excess attenuation, voice band
forest_db_100m.note: 1.9 measured in French Guiana rainforest; 6.6 FEMA medium-dense woods at 500 Hz (9.8 at 1 kHz); about 20 in older tropical work. A tenfold spread: the reason for the range

ambient_night_dba.label: Ambient, forest edge at dusk and night
ambient_night_dba.note: Insects peak at dawn, dusk and night; the design case

margin_db.label: Margin above ambient to be heard
margin_db.note: FEMA: at least 10 dB above ambient

building_open_db.label: Building loss, open eaves or windows
building_open_db.note: FEMA Table 3, light frame, windows open

mast_m.label: Speaker mounting height
mast_m.note: Mount high: sound from a source at or below 1 m loses its low frequencies to the ground (Marten and Marler)

clearing_m.label: Village clearing radius before the forest starts
clearing_m.note: Derived per settlement from buildings and canopy in Stage 3

t1_cutoff_people.label: Smallest gain worth a village speaker
t1_cutoff_people.note: Below this a $25 receiver is cheaper

t1_installed_usd.label: Village speaker installed: speaker head, GEO receiver and controller, mount or mast, solar
t1_installed_usd.note: For the scale check only; replace with vendor quotes (brief §15)

people_per_village.label: People per village
people_per_village.note: The community-receiver rule in sensors.json: one receiver per about 500 rural people
